{"title": "AWEngine at a glance", "doc": "# AWEngine at a glance

AWEngine is a small workflow engine for collaborative agents. A workflow is declared in YAML and the engine moves typed artifacts between its nodes.

## Collaboration

The analyst, writer and editor are separate agents. Each one owns a different responsibility, so a later agent can inspect the earlier agent's work instead of silently trusting it.

## Verification

The engine, not an agent, runs the verify command and decides whether the workflow passed its goal.
"}
